budget_basis: ZERO SPENT, and the plan cells exist only because the metering runs on the FAKE transport too. 7 cells x 4 rows = 28 requests built, doubled to 56 so the check can be re-run once inside one run id; 7 x 15.011 = 105.1 audio seconds accounted, ceiling 240; 0.3 GPU hours nominal. NOTHING IS ACTUALLY SPENT: the transport is core.flight.runtime.WireCheckTransport, which never opens a socket, and the realized frozen-core contacts are 0. The seven REGISTERED KV flights do not share this run id -- each has its own experiment fragment, its own plan, its own exposure row and its own single recovery allowance.
comparator: None. This fragment makes no contrast; the KV comparators are named in each cell's own registered experiment fragment.
decision_rule: There is none: a wire check has no decision. It passes or it refuses, and the refusal is the finding.
gate: PASS requires, for EACH of the seven cells: 4 of 4 requests built; exactly ONE phase in the run_phases receipt with rows 4 and contacts 4; every payload's last history turn role == control; the resolved system message byte-identical to KC-S1b's own; the contact instruction equal, on every row, to the KV-0 arm's instruction with that view's block substituted for KV-0's; and rails.runner's own containment fold raising on none of them.
never_fly_this_fragment: THIS FRAGMENT IS FOR --wire-check AND --dry-run ONLY. It has no exposure-ledger row and must never be run with --run: a real transport under it would spend contacts nothing has registered. The seven registered KV experiment fragments are the ones that fly.
population: Four rows of the frozen DEV-1000 runtime view, named in the populations block above, contacted zero times.

populations.basis: The SAME four rows the sealed closed-list wiring proof, the MF-5 SLURP phase smoke and the KC-S1 smoke all flew: the first four DEV-1000 sample ids in sorted order. Named HERE, in the registered fragment, rather than on a command line, so a check can never quietly touch four different rows than the ones its exposure row names (the SAEA-E22-ESB precedent). No contact is made against them here.

purpose: FOUR-ROW REQUEST-HALF WIRE CHECK of all seven KV arms, before any of them is registered to fly. Zero model contacts and zero sockets: core.flight.runtime.WireCheckGate and WireCheckTransport stand in for the gate and the transport, and everything between them is real -- the real core.config.compose, the real roster with every media file re-hashed, the real knowledge-snapshot load and hash verification, the real sealed-manifest predecessor binding, the real phase program, the real KV state fill reading TRAIN, the real containment fold on every contact instruction, and the real request build through the payload-binding stage. Its responses are the transport's canned string and are not a measurement of anything.
what_is_not_read: No wire-check output is a task measurement. The responses are core.flight.runtime.WireCheckTransport's canned string; no comparator, verdict or admission is touched.
